verified.value: Merged. 53 tests pass on the fixtures with no network. The client only accepts the four public info types; there is no signing or order surface. Real HL spot depth on 10-18: UBTC 0.06 bp at $3k, 1.07 bp at $300k; UETH 0.21 / 5.10 bp. At the 3,000 USDC pilot size, slippage is under 1 bp, which is well inside the S-602 friction assumption (5 bp + 0.1 × vol), so the friction column in the simulations is conservative for the pilot. The $3M = inf reading only means beyond the visible book (l2Book shows the top levels), not no liquidity; it matters at fund scale, not now. Registry / consolidator entry for HL spot stays out until the executor host exists (T-015). Merger change: HlSpotClient no longer carries its own urllib call; it validates the request type and hands the POST to hyperliquid_collector.info_post_sync, the repo's one Hyperliquid network path, so the fetch-entry budget (test_sense_entrypoints, only shrinks) stays at 24. The first merge attempt failed exactly there (25 > 24).
